entities.summary: Dragutin Mate is a former Slovenian diplomat and politician of Croat origins. He was a member of the Slovenian Democratic Party (2008–2016). Between 2004 and 2008 he served as Minister of Interior in the centre-right government led by Janez Janša and between 2011 and 2014, he was a deputy in the National Assembly.
